name: Sphinx
tagline: Veteran C++ full-text search server with SphinxQL, still shipping as Sphinx 3.
description: Sphinx is one of the oldest open-source full-text engines, long paired with MySQL for site search before Elasticsearch existed. Development continues under Sphinx Technologies as Sphinx 3, which added a document store, its own HNSW and scalar-quantized vector indexes (3.8) and async replication (3.9). However, the public GitHub repository is frozen at 2.x, Sphinx 3 ships as free binaries rather than an open repo, and most of the community moved to its fork Manticore Search. Consider it mainly if you already run Sphinx; for new projects Manticore offers the same lineage with an open development model.

license.name: Sphinx 3: free binaries, dual-licensed (2.x was GPL-2.0)

pricing.notes: Sphinx 3 binaries are free to download; commercial licensing and support from Sphinx Technologies.

scale.notes: Distributed indexes and agent mirrors are configured by hand; 3.9 adds async master-follower replication.

strengths: Very fast indexing and querying with low memory use
SQL interface over the MySQL protocol works with existing MySQL clients
Long track record in production since the 2000s
weaknesses: Sphinx 3 source is not developed in the open; GitHub repo stuck at 2.x
Small community, most users migrated to Manticore
Sparse ecosystem of modern client libraries and integrations
Manual sharding and limited HA story
notIdealFor: Greenfield projects wanting an active open-source community
